annotations.title: Filing document: links, PDF and page images

description: Return where a filing's documents are: the primary document on EDGAR, the filing index, the full submission text, the inline XBRL viewer, a FinancialMD URL that serves the primary HTML document, and URLs for the same document as a PDF with selectable text and as page images. format "pages" renders the PDF if needed and returns its page count; add page to get the URL of that page's PNG image, so an answer can cite a page. The first render of a document can take some seconds; an upstream_unavailable error with a retry time means it is still rendering. A document past the rendering limits answers not_covered with the EDGAR link. Use it when you need to read, link or cite a page of the text of a filing.

format.description: links (default): the document URLs. pages: the PDF page count and its URLs.

page.description: A page number of the PDF, from 1. Implies format "pages"; the answer names that page's image URL.

name: filing_document

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: links: { accession, registry, form, filed, primary_doc, document_url, index_url, full_text_url, inline_xbrl_viewer_url, html_url, pdf: { available, url, pages_url, page_image_url_template, note } }. pages: { accession, form, filed, document_url, pages, pdf_url, pdf_bytes, page_image_url_template, page_image, images_inlined, images_skipped, render_version, rendered_at }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.
